description: This file defines macros and functions related to encoding strings as ASCII codes within a CMake build configuration. It includes a macro 'string_codes' that assigns ASCII codes to variable names, and a function 'string_codes_print' to output the variable values.

methods.name: string_codes
methods.description: Macro that assigns ASCII codes to variables based on input arguments.

methods.name: string_codes_print
methods.description: Function that prints out the stored ASCII code variables.
